title: Narrative-Driven Travel Planning: Geoculturally-Grounded Script Generation with Evolutionary Itinerary Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the script quality evaluation scores (e.g., narrative coherence, cultural fit, spatiotemporal consistency) of LLM-generated travel scripts for non-Western cultural contexts (Chinese cities) against Western contexts (European cities) to identify performance disparities.
Evaluating the difference in generation quality and overall scores between travel scripts prompted and generated in Chinese versus those generated in English.
